title: When Do Markets Work? Multiplex Networks and Efficiency
abstract: arXiv:2605.21117v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study an Arrow-Debreu economy with externalities generated by multiplex networks. Market equilibrium prices reflect not only preferences and the scarcity of goods, but also consumers' network positions induced by goods-specific externalities and the linkages across goods arising from the endogenous budget constraint. We quantify the departures of equilibrium allocations from Pareto efficiency using both a utility-based measure of efficiency loss and a coefficient of resource utilization, thereby linking network multiplexity quantitatively to equilibrium performance. These measures also identify zero-efficiency-loss cases: competitive equilibria are efficient when the relevant network-centrality vectors are parallel, a condition satisfied, in particular, when all networks are regular or when all layers share the same network structure. translated_title: 市场何时有效？多层网络与效率
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个由多层网络产生外部性的阿罗-德布鲁经济。市场均衡价格不仅反映偏好和商品的稀缺性，还反映了由商品特定外部性所引致的消费者网络位置，以及由内生预算约束所产生的商品之间的关联。我们利用基于效用的效率损失度量方法和资源利用系数来量化均衡配置偏离帕累托效率的程度，从而将网络的多层性定量地与均衡绩效联系起来。这些度量方法还识别出了零效率损失的情形：当相关的网络中心性向量相互平行时，竞争均衡是有效的；特别地，当所有网络都是正则网络或所有层共享相同的网络结构时，这一条件即可得到满足。当竞争市场对商品的配置缺乏效率时，可以通过实施的林达尔均衡……
tldr: 本文在具有多层网络外部性的阿罗-德布鲁经济中量化了均衡配置偏离帕累托效率的程度，并证明当各网络中心性向量平行（如所有网络为正则网络或各层结构相同）时竞争均衡有效，而在市场配置无效率时可通过林达尔均衡加以纠正。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies the departure of equilibrium allocations from Pareto efficiency in an Arrow-Debreu economy with multiplex network externalities, showing that competitive equilibria are efficient when network-centrality vectors are parallel (e.g., when networks are regular or layers share the same structure), and that inefficiencies can be corrected through a Lindahl equilibrium.
